notes: Director's cut for U1-E5 'Silver Empire' (script v3, Maya+Marcus). 13 scenes. Each scene carries a 'turns' [start, end] partition of the 47 TTS segments (t00..t46, including the two 5s self-test silences) — run refit_durations.py against the rendered turns dir to replace the estimated duration_sec values with measured sums (the mix is a straight concat, so this is exact). Visual grammar: KeywordPops on Huallpa, pieces of eight, mita, Guamán Poma, Manila galleons; CausalChainSlide for the silver→money→prices exam move; StatSlide for the 4 Philip II bankruptcies; ImageSlides on the 1553 Cieza de León Potosí woodcut, the 1590 de Bry mine engraving, the 1598 de Bry cruelty engraving, and the c.1565 Huys caravel fleet. No blank backgrounds. Eyes-closed-safe.
